links.outcome: Ambient scribe documentation time, edit burden, and clinician preference versus dictation in simulated ED
links.effect: Mean dictation time 2:05 min vs 1:15 min AI note editing (39% savings, p < 0.0001); 69% of 240 sections needed no edits; 63% preferred AI note.
links.quote: Mean dictation time was 2:05 min compared to 1:15 min for AI note editing, representing a 39% time savings (p < 0.0001).

links.outcome: Extent and type of edits needed in AI scribe-generated note sections
links.effect: Of 240 note sections, 69% required no edits; edits most common in History and Plan sections; 76% of edits were minor.
links.quote: Of 240 total note sections, 69% required no edits; edits were most common in the "History" and "Plan" sections.

screen.reason: Empirical study testing an ambient AI scribe against traditional dictation in a simulated emergency department setting with standardized patients.
